title: Concrete coefficient and simultaneous matrix-model data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a small site $(C,J)$. Let $A$ be the lifted integer ring of $E$, $A_n$ the lifted quotient $A/(\ell)^{n+1}$, $B_n=\underline{A_n}$, and $B=\varprojlim_n B_n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Record the actual scalar and coefficient quotient maps, ordinary completed scalar realization, normalized derived reductions and quotient transitions, exact restriction to slices and its localization interchange [def-weil-pbc-successive-derived-quotient-data, lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization, def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. For a scalar matrix $d:A^a\to A^b$, use the cone of its degree-zero map in degrees $-1,0$, its entrywise reductions, and their constant realizations. The type $\operatorname{SimultaneousModels}(L,U,d)$ consists of derived isomorphisms from every restricted reduction of $L[0]$ to this single matrix cone; term bases with the specified reduced differential and zero other terms; quotient chain maps whose maps in both bases are the actual scalar quotients; and the commuting square with the original normalized derived transition for every $m\le n$. These concrete constructions formerly belonged to the matrix-reduction theorem's module: every name, type, and body is preserved.
